==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}}
[[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] have been in [[Falme]] for weeks. Nynaeve is still sickened by the sight of ''[[damane]]''. She thinks she sees [[Padan Fain]] among the crowds, followed by a high ranking [[Seanchan]] servant. She has taken off the [[Great Serpent ring|serpent ring]]. Elayne tells her she has stolen apples, and Nynaeve says she shouldn’t steal things, but was surprised at how expensive everything was here. Elayne briefly [[One Power|channeled]] for a distraction to pull off the heist. Nynaeve has been trying to release ''damane'' that they pass on the street, but the ''damane'' are not interested in being freed. Nynaeve is still trying to figure out how to get those collars off. The two are staking out the ''damane'' quarters, which they know as such because women have been seen taken inside to be collared. Nynaeve needs to figure out how to free [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] before it is too late.

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene looks out the window from her room. She can see [[Renna Emain|Renna]] in the garden. Min is in another house but has fewer restrictions than Egwene. She uses the power frequently to try and remove the collar. The bracelet hangs on a peg on the wall. A ''damane'' who tries to move the bracelet will feel ill. Min arrives for her “weekly visit.” She has a nice dress, and a ribbon in her hair. Egwene asks why she’s wearing a dress, and Min says she had to. The Seanchan did not know what to do with her, since she does not channel the way Egwene does, so they decided she was a serving girl and should dress as such. Min says she has found a ship captain who is willing to take them away from the town. Egwene says she will have to stay here, as she cannot get out of the ''[[A'dam|a’dam]]''. Egwene asks Min to give her a knife so she can demonstrate that ''damane'' cannot even touch a weapon.

Egwene has encountered two [[Aes Sedai]] who have been captured. One is [[Ryma Galfrey]] now called Pura. Egwene asks Min to remember Ryma and her since the Seanchan are going to send her by ship to Seanchan in a few days. Renna gave her a test yesterday and Egwene was able to pick out different types of ore while blindfolded, showing that she would be useful in [[Delving]] for ore. Renna comes in and can tell that Egwene was channeling without permission. As punishment she changes Egwene's name to Tuli, after a pet kitten she once had.
